implementation.targetScope: Non-compiler JSONC configuration discovery, parsing, extends/path rebasing, solution references, templates and explicit cache used by current/app Vite path plugins. Native TypeScript mode and CLI are not implemented.

changes: Independent zero-dependency reader; no upstream runtime copied and no compiler loaded for ordinary configuration resolution.
Own-property merges preserve prototype-looking keys as data; source extends arrays remain in their declared order.
Cache lookup respects root/config-name settings and clear separates in-flight work from the new cache generation.
Extends and reference cycles/depth fail with bounded diagnostics. Non-object configurations fail explicitly.
Ordinary JSON configuration packages created after a negative runtime lookup remain resolvable on Bun; exported packages remain governed by the runtime resolver.

caller.scope: VentiMath vite.config.mts calls vite-tsconfig-paths5.1.4 with parseNative:false. Unchanged current6.1.1 and app5.1.4 plugins resolve inherited aliases in Vite6.3.5 builds using this reader; the private app tsconfig is compared read-only.
